FROM "eventspaces" e

  AND (
    LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
    OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%hall%'
    OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
    OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%room%'
  );

WITH chefs AS (
    SELECT
        id AS chef_id,
        name AS chef_name,
        language AS chef_language
    FROM
        staff
    WHERE
        LOWER("role") = 'chef'
),
servers AS (
    SELECT
        id AS server_id,
        name AS server_name,
        language AS server_language
    FROM
        staff
    WHERE
        LOWER("role") = 'server'
)

SELECT
    c.chef_id,
    c.chef_name,
    c.chef_language,
    s.server_id,
    s.server_name,
    s.server_language,
    (c.chef_language = 'English') AS chef_speaks_english,
    (s.server_language = 'English') AS server_speaks_english
FROM
    chefs c
JOIN
    servers s ON LOWER(c.chef_language) = LOWER(s.server_language)
WHERE
    c.chef_id != s.server_id;

    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"

    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS system_names,
    string_agg(
        CASE
            WHEN s."is_active" = 'True' THEN 'Активна'
            ELSE 'Неактивна'
        END,
        ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name"
    ) AS system_statuses
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."id";

263:
WITH software_developer_positions AS (
    SELECT
        p."id" AS position_id,
        p."title"
    FROM
        "position" p
    WHERE
        LOWER(p."title") = 'software developer'
),
salary_data AS (
    SELECT
        sd."positionid",
        sd."hourly_rate",
        sd."salary_range",
        ad."deadline"
    FROM
        "salarydetails" sd
    JOIN
        "applicationdeadline" ad ON sd."positionid" = ad."positionid"
    WHERE
        sd."positionid" IN (SELECT position_id FROM software_developer_positions)
),
estimated_rates AS (
    SELECT
        positionid,
        hourly_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN hourly_rate IS NOT NULL THEN hourly_rate
            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN salary_range ~ '^\$[0-9]+k - \$[0-9]+k$' THEN
                        (CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(salary_range, '-', 1), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                         CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(salary_range, '-', 2), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) * 1000) / 2.0 / 2080
                    ELSE NULL
                END
        END AS calculated_hourly_rate
    FROM
        salary_data
    WHERE
        deadline >= CURRENT_DATE
        OR deadline IS NULL
)
SELECT
    MIN(calculated_hourly_rate) AS min_hourly_rate,
    MAX(calculated_hourly_rate) AS max_hourly_rate,
    AVG(calculated_hourly_rate) AS avg_hourly_rate
FROM
    estimated_rates
WHERE
    calculated_hourly_rate IS NOT NULL;

CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN d."building" IS NOT NULL THEN d."building"
        WHEN c."roomnumber" IS NOT NULL THEN c."roomnumber"
        WHEN f."type" IS NOT NULL THEN f."type"
    END AS "address",
    s."city"
FROM
    departments d
FULL OUTER JOIN
    classes c ON d."building" LIKE '%' || c."roomnumber" || '%'
FULL OUTER JOIN
    facilities f ON d."building" LIKE '%' || f."type" || '%'
                 OR c."roomnumber" LIKE '%' || f."type" || '%'
LEFT JOIN
    students s ON d."building" LIKE '%' || s."campus" || '%'
               OR c."roomnumber" LIKE '%' || s."campus" || '%'
               OR f."type" LIKE '%' || s."campus" || '%'
WHERE
    d."building" IS NOT NULL
    OR c."roomnumber" IS NOT NULL
    OR f."type" IS NOT NULL;
